svg.text: Floor plan, dimensions and structural bays
Dimensions are to interior finish face
Four structural bays at 11'-3" on centre
Single 6'-0" entry; east gable is a mirror wall
Standing / reception at 5 sq ft per person: 180
Chairs only at 7 sq ft per person: 128
Tables + seating at 15 sq ft per person: 60
Post count and spacing scaled from photograph —
field-verify before ordering or committing to a layout.
Roof pitch is unwrapped timber; mylar stops at the
horizontal tie-beam level on walls and posts.
